doc.title: Peter Ecklund interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 14, 1998

title: New Orleans revival style and trips to Preservation Hall
summary: The Allen group plays New Orleans revival style, the music Ecklund heard on trips to New Orleans and Preservation Hall in the late 1960s.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Oh, that’s interesting. And that was pretty straight forward Dixieland?

That was New Orleans revival style, that’s what he likes. He plays kind of like George Lewis. That’s the music I heard in the late ‘60s when I was in college. I made a lot of trips to New Orleans on vacations and heard some of that music when it was still pretty decent, at Preservation Hall and all that, and that was really a great experience.
